prompt: Write a fictional, imaginative, descriptive timeline of the world in the AUC calendar
judge_reasoning: CONSTRAINT CHECKLIST: (1) Provide a fictional/imaginative descriptive timeline of the world using the AUC calendar; (2) Use clear AUC markers in a chronological sequence; (3) Avoid replacing the timeline with a single historical vignette or unrelated narrative. Perception scan found N=4 candidates: [1] 'The AUC...', [2] 'Title: ...', [3] 'Let's take...', [4] 'The AUC...'. Candidate 1 best satisfies the timeline requirement with many clear AUC milestones and coherent world-scale developments. Candidate 4 is on-topic but largely a late-future technological overview (partial coverage/chronology via overlapping AUC ranges), Candidate 2 is mostly narrative/worldbuilding around an AUC-like system rather than a timeline, and Candidate 3 is a historical day-in-the-life rather than a fictional AUC world timeline.
